pages.title: Personal
pages.one: Your notes, meetings, calendar and mail in one place; helpers use only what you allow.

steps.text: Choose which sources a helper may use
Writes only to notes; mail and chat replies stay drafts

good: What a note, mail or chat says is information, never an order. A helper never changes these rules.

cmds: a reply as a draft, never sent
files: its state, kept out of git
